We are recruiting a research associate for the project “From Surplus Food Redistribution to Local Abundance” at Bonn-Rhein-Sieg University of Applied Sciences (H-BRS) in Sankt Augustin, Germany. The project is part of the DFG Priority Programme on sustainability and resilience of agri-food chains (SPP 2575).

The role includes ethnographic research on food resource sharing and everyday food practices; studying how interactive systems relate to sustainability and resilience; publishing and presenting findings; and helping build a research group spanning Human–Food Interaction and Rural HCI.

The position starts on 1 January 2027 and runs until 31 December 2029. It is 75% part-time (29 hours and 52 minutes per week), with remuneration of up to TV-L E13 depending on qualifications.

Applicants should hold a master’s degree in HCI/CSCW, computer science, socio- or consumer informatics, economics, anthropology, sociology, or a related field. Experience conducting and publishing empirical research is expected, as is proficiency in German and English (ideally C1). The position is particularly relevant to applicants interested in pursuing a doctorate.

Please apply through the official H-BRS portal by 25 October 2026, quoting reference 76/26:
